worked_solution:
The cardinality of a finite set $T$ is the number of elements in $T.$

Let's start by listing all the elements of $T:$

$$
0,\,{-2,-3,-4},\,{9,10,11,12}
$$

Note that ${-2,-3,-4}$ and ${9,10,11,12}$ each count as single elements of $T.$

Since $T$ has $3$ elements, the cardinality is $|T|=3.$
